reviews.title: Size, speed, storage & user friendly, to boot!
reviews.body: Needed to replace my Dell Inspiron that was still running on Windows 10, so I took some time researching laptops that would meet my needs. This HP checked all my boxes, including my budget. It was easy to set up and start using and I’m very satisfied with my purchase. I love my new laptop!
